data.command: What OS is installed on the servers?

data.text:
```
[webapp@prod-app-03 ~]$ uname -a
Linux prod-app-03.corp.internal 6.9.4-210.el10.x86_64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Mar 12 09:44:17 UTC 2024 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

[webapp@prod-app-03 ~]$ cat /etc/os-release
NAME="Rocky Linux"
VERSION="10.2 (Cobalt Ridge)"
ID="rocky"
ID_LIKE="rhel centos fedora"
VERSION_ID="10.2"
PLATFORM_ID="platform:el10"

ANSI_COLOR="0;32"
LOGO="rocky-logo"
CPE_NAME="cpe:/o:rocky:rocky:10:baseos"

REDHAT_SUPPORT_PRODUCT_VERSION="10.2"

[webapp@prod-app-03 ~]$ hostnamectl
   Static hostname: prod-app-03.corp.internal
         Icon name: computer-vm
           Chassis: vm
        Machine ID: 7f3a9c21d4e84b2f9a1c6e05b8d2f734
           Boot ID: 2c8e1b5a9f3d4e7a8b6c0d1e2f3a4b5c
    Virtualization: kvm
  Operating System: Rocky Linux 10.2 (Cobalt Ridge)
       CPE OS Name: cpe:/o:rocky:rocky:10:baseos
            Kernel: Linux 6.9.4-210.el10.x86_64
      Architecture: x86-64
   Hardware Vendor: QEMU
    Hardware Model: Standard PC (Q35 + ICH9, 2009)

[webapp@prod-app-03 ~]$ uptime
 14:23:07 up 87 days,  3:41,  2 users,  load average: 0.42, 0.38, 0.35
```

From what I can see, the web tier (prod-app-01 through prod-app-04) all run Rocky Linux 10.2. The database backend (prod-db-01) should be on the same image, though I only have access to the app nodes from this account. The legacy reporting box (legacy-rep-01) is still on an older Rocky 8.x build — it's been flagged for migration for months.
